title: Surreal Time Reaper
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a purple hooded cloak holds a large green alarm clock while riding a blue dragon-like creature. Below, a zombie-like gangster in a suit and fedora holds a revolver, surrounded by a hot air balloon, floating clocks, playing cards, flowers, fruits, and beetles against a dramatic red and purple sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene featuring a skeletal Grim Reaper in flowing purple robes holding a large green alarm clock, riding a vibrant blue dragon with sharp teeth. In the foreground a green-skinned gangster zombie in a pinstripe suit and fedora aims a revolver. A purple hot air balloon with dripping paint floats nearby with playing cards and mechanical beetles flying through a dramatic blood-red and purple sky filled with melting clocks and glowing clouds.
